title: Sparse Coverage: Semantic Center Representations for Patent Prior-Art Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.16918v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Patent prior-art retrieval is a recall-oriented search task over long and highly structured technical documents. Dense retrieval improves semantic matching, but single-vector representations may compress multiple technical components, functions, and constraints into a single embedding. We propose Sparse Coverage, an unsupervised semantic retrieval framework that maps local span embeddings to a sparse vocabulary of embedding-space centers. The centers are selected with a coverage-oriented k-center objective, and spans activate nearby centers to produce sparse representations compatible with inverted-index retrieval. Experiments on CLEF-IP 2013 show that Sparse Coverage matches or exceeds the document-level recall of strong dense patent encoders in several configurations, while remaining competitive for passage-level retrieval. translated_title: 稀疏覆盖：用于专利现有技术检索的语义中心表示
translated_abstract: 专利现有技术检索是一项面向召回率的搜索任务，涉及长且高度结构化的技术文档。密集检索改善了语义匹配，但单一向量表示可能将多个技术组件、功能和约束压缩到一个嵌入中。我们提出了稀疏覆盖（Sparse Coverage），一种无监督的语义检索框架，将局部跨度嵌入映射到嵌入空间中心的稀疏词汇表。这些中心通过覆盖导向的k中心目标进行选择，跨度激活邻近中心以产生与倒排索引检索兼容的稀疏表示。在CLEF-IP 2013上的实验表明，稀疏覆盖在多种配置下匹配或超过了强密集专利编码器的文档级召回率，同时在段落级检索中保持竞争力。通过结合局部语义证据与稀疏倒排索引搜索，稀疏覆盖提供了一种有效的替代方案。
tldr: 稀疏覆盖通过无监督的语义中心映射和稀疏倒排索引，在专利现有技术检索中实现了与密集编码器相当的召回率，同时提高了效率。
en_tdlr: Sparse Coverage achieves recall comparable to dense encoders in patent prior-art retrieval via unsupervised semantic center mapping and sparse inverted-index search.
